auth.users.note: Own allowlisted account fields only; no passwords, tokens or raw metadata.

auth.identities.note: Own provider names and dates; no provider identifiers or identity JSON.

public.account_deletion_log.excluded: Deletion fence and security retention record; manual privacy review, not a self-service payload.

public.achievements.excluded: Global achievement definitions; own completion history comes from user_achievements.

public.admin_audit_logs.excluded: Security audit with third-party snapshots; requires separate manual privacy review.

public.admin_users.note: Own administrator boolean only; grantor and internal timestamps excluded.

public.auction_chat_messages.note: Only messages authored by the requesting player.

public.auctions.note: Own involvement only; counterparties reduced to existing public presentation.

public.billing_accounts.excluded: Provider linkage, anti-fraud holds and operational leases require manual privacy review; never export nonces or lease tokens.

public.billing_entitlement_config.excluded: Global provider configuration; not an individual account record.

public.billing_request_limits.excluded: Transient anti-abuse counters; manual privacy review rather than exposing billing scopes.

public.billing_webhook_events.excluded: Provider event deduplication and security records; manual privacy review.

public.card_franchises.note: Only catalogue references associated with the requesting player.

public.card_reports.note: Own submissions only; internal moderation snapshots and status excluded.

public.card_share_creations.excluded: Share anti-abuse history; manual privacy review, no share capabilities.

public.card_shares.note: Own projection; link tokens and share URLs excluded.

public.cards.note: Referenced cards only, not a dump of the global catalogue.

public.data_export_state.excluded: Transient export reservation and receipt state; never expose request capabilities.

public.private_message_reads.excluded: Private read receipts contain counterpart identifiers; manual privacy review, no received correspondence export.

public.private_messages.note: Only messages authored by the requesting player, not entire conversations.

public.pro_access_grants.excluded: Operator attribution and free-text notes require manual privacy review; never expose another account's operator data.

public.profile_media_assets.note: Own allowlisted metadata and sanitized URLs, no storage capabilities.

public.profile_visit_receipts.note: Retained own legacy history; retired feature does not erase exportable history.

public.referral_codes.note: Only the requesting player's invitation code and creation date.

public.referrals.note: Own sent/received referral events and reward dates; no counterparty UUID, email, code or profile.

public.user_reports.note: Own submissions only; received reports, free text and snapshots excluded.

public.wall_post_replies.note: Own replies only, including GIF and attachment-presence metadata.

public.wishlist.note: Compatibility view of wishlists, not duplicated in the file.

storage.buckets.excluded: Global storage configuration, not an individual account record.

storage.objects.note: Only own allowlisted file metadata; no binary contents, paths or signed URLs.
